description: This file defines functions for collecting warnings related to empty allowlist policies in a doctor/channel context, including handling of allowFrom lists, group policies, and related configurations.

methods.name: usesSenderBasedGroupAllowlist
methods.description: Checks if the channel uses sender-based group allowlist based on capabilities.

methods.name: allowsGroupAllowFromFallback
methods.description: Determines if fallback to allowFrom is permitted for group allowlist.
